frequency_question: What proportion of major capital buffer or reserve requirement adjustments successfully clear all procedural, quantitative impact study, and voting steps within a 14-month operational window from initial proposal?
membership_rule: Includes all formally proposed changes to macroprudential capital buffers (like CCyB or supplementary leverage ratios) by the central bank since the inception of the regulatory framework; excludes routine monetary policy rate changes.

cases.name: 2023 Basel III Endgame Proposal and Review Phase

coverage_note: 4 major capital buffer review cycles identified; covers the universe of U.S. macroprudential capital buffer calibration events.
known_gaps: Informal preliminary discussions prior to formal notice of proposed rulemaking are not separately tracked.
skeleton: Regulatory rulemakings involving quantitative thresholds and public comment periods, broken into proposal phase (60-90 days), comment and review phase (120-180 days), final vote and implementation phase (60-90 days).
multiplier: 4 distinct major regulatory adjustment cycles evaluated for full procedural completion within timeframe constraints.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and central bank governance structures remain legally stable over multi-year periods.
